vb_textbox.text: 1. Firstly the gnome you pick initially should be random2. If the one you picked give a yield of around 3-4 then pick try picking the other type of gnome next time as it should give a higher yield.3. Figure out which gnome brings in the higher and lower yield, typically in my experience the gnome with the taller hat was the one who gave the bigger yields. And the shorter had did the opposite.4. There is a hidden rule being if you select a gnome, i.e. the one with the tall hat multiple times, usually 2-3 times, you will notice that he will give a lower yield. When this happens you will want to select the shorter gnome as he will usually give a bigger yield compared to the taller gnomes temporarily reduced amount. This should reset after a few rounds.5. Click the space bar quickly, once after selecting the gnome and once on the basket screen, as in my experience there is a short delay after you click and it selects which sometimes results in "Too slow"6. Good luck & Have FUN!
